_comment: Career By the Numbers, per kind of work. 'Any kind of work' uses every theme in prompt.json in its everyday wording. Each named workplace below rewrites the themes that belong to that work, in its own words: a label for the brief and its own playful and nostalgic details. A set for a named workplace plans only from the themes listed here (plus the road to retirement, which every working life shares), so a workshop set never asks about staplers or reply-all and a school set never asks about the van. A theme that does not belong to a workplace is simply left out of it. Theme keys, groups and weights come from prompt.json; a detail never names a subject word of another group (no mugs outside drinks, no pens outside supplies), so the client's group caps read each question as the theme it was briefed for.
